summary: Agentic-mesh Web Application – Authentication and Dashboard Functionality
title: Agentic-mesh Web Application – Authentication and Dashboard Functionality
description: The Agentic-mesh application provides a landing page (index.html) linking to the login page (home.html) where users enter email and password to sign in. Upon successful authentication, users are taken to the dashboard (dashboard.html) which offers system actions such as running diagnostics, downloading access logs, and signing out.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the user is on the login page "/home.html", when they enter a valid email "user@example.com" and password "Password123" and click the "Sign In" button, then they should be redirected to the dashboard page "/dashboard.html".

Given the user is on the login page "/home.html", when they click the "Toggle Password" button, then the password input field type should change from "password" to "text" (making the password visible).
Given the user is on the dashboard page "/dashboard.html", when they click the "Sign Out" button, then they should be redirected to the login page "/home.html" and the login form should be visible.

Given the user is on the dashboard page "/dashboard.html", when they click the "Run System Diagnostics" button, then a diagnostics results message "Diagnostics completed successfully" should be displayed on the page.
Given the user is on the dashboard page "/dashboard.html", when they click the "Download Access Logs" button, then a file download should start with the filename "access_logs.txt".
Given the user is on the landing page "/index.html", when they click the "home.html" link, then they should be navigated to the login page "/home.html".
